game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Torchlit Cave Mouth Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about belt_count to power up the torchbearer and open the lantern post.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
